query:
SELECT 
  venue,
  COUNT(*) as student_count,
  SUM(feePerQuarter) as total_quarterly_fee,
  AVG(feePerQuarter) as avg_fee_per_student
FROM students
GROUP BY venue
ORDER BY total_quarterly_fee DESC;
